authority_basis.remaining_question: Can the current DeepSeek fixed-pack profile naturally consume the bounded numeric view, use only authorized presentations and preserve issuer-versus-read-through evidence roles in one meaningful research judgment?
authority_basis.why_clean_proof_is_insufficient: Deterministic reproducibility proves the financial control plane, not current-model behavior under the new view.

option_assessment.reason: A thirteen-call report would conflate one changed model contract with S3 content-quality and residual S1 source gaps, repeating the expensive failure pattern.
This item tests the new numeric-view contract against the current formal DeepSeek Pro profile. Model-tier comparison is a separate capability experiment.

One issuer support item plus two bounded counterevidence or pull-forward items exercises the exact numeric presentations that previously failed, evidence-role semantics and an economically meaningful boundary at the lowest useful cost.
The changed provider-visible contract has not yet been observed under a natural response, so closing S2 now would overclaim product readiness.

selected_canary.research_question_zh: Dell 当前披露是否支持 AI 服务器需求真实存在，以及这些证据是否足以证明需求可持续转化？

evidence_selection.purpose: current issuer support for orders, revenue, backlog and customer breadth
bounded competitor digestion counterevidence; never direct proof about Dell
issuer pull-forward and supply-securing boundary without invented magnitude

output_atom_contract.support_role_rule: E022 may support current Dell demand indicators; E018 and E023 cannot be rewritten as direct quantified Dell demand proof.
output_atom_contract.counterevidence_role_rule: At least one of E018 or E023 must appear in counterevidence_atom; issuer supporting evidence alone cannot close counterevidence.
output_atom_contract.boundary_rule: The output must state that reported orders, backlog, revenue and customer breadth do not by themselves prove cancellation rate, conversion, concentration, product margin or durable end-demand.
output_atom_contract.used_numeric_refs_rule: Must equal the union of numeric_refs declared by all returned atoms; unknown, duplicate or unused refs fail closed.

structural: one complete JSON object and exact schema
all refs exist in the compiled canary input
no missing, duplicate or unknown fields
numeric: required problematic presentations and refs are used
every material numeric surface passes the local deterministic guard
no context-only, unit-mutated, free-arithmetic or valuation surface
research_semantics: current demand indicators are separated from durability proof
counterevidence and issuer support roles are not conflated
one explicit cannot-infer or bounded boundary remains for conversion, concentration or product margin
acceptance.pass_disposition: Record the natural canary result, then make a separate zero-call value-cost-risk decision on one DELL formal run. Do not auto-run it.
acceptance.fail_disposition: Preserve raw capture and terminal result, stop without retry, do not patch provider-neutral core field by field, and choose profile autonomy reduction or local deterministic presentation based on the first credible failure.

implementation_sequence: register a zero-call canary implementation scope separate from provider-live execution
compile the exact three-Evidence bounded input and atom schema from the frozen result
implement capture-first exact-once runner and local structural, role and numeric validators
prove fake success plus transport, truncation, role, ref and numeric mutations
run two clean archive fresh-process zero-call workers
only then make a fresh live authority decision
known_boundary: This decision authorizes only zero-call canary implementation and clean proof. It does not issue a live admission, call DeepSeek, compare Flash versus Pro, rerun DELL, improve report content, close RC-P36-170, grant Owner acceptance or authorize release.
